instructions_to_main_agent: Include Google Auth button mock with real profile state, as well as Dealer Email / Password login modal.
Implement Voice Incident creation: user clicks Record, speaks or triggers audio wave simulation, speech is transcribed to text with AI key details extracted (Model, Problem Type, Urgency).
Implement Photo Incident creation: upload sample or select pre-loaded car/two-wheeler photo with AI damage detector overlay.
Build the Dealer Orchestration engine: dynamic filtering by AI priority score (High/Medium/Low), auto-assignment to technicians, and live SLA countdown timer.

Build the Amazon Connect Contact Control Panel (CCP) component on dealer side: softphone simulator, agent status toggle (Available, On Call, After Work), real-time call transcript, and incident quick-attach.
Build transparent live tracking view for end user: real-time status stepper, progress percentage, technician notes, and contact button.

Build KPI & Escalation dashboard: charts for SLA compliance %, Average Time to Resolve, Breached Tickets, and automated Escalation Triggers (Level 1 Dealer -> Level 2 OEM Regional -> Level 3 OEM Quality VP).
Add 'data-testid' to ALL interactive controls, inputs, buttons, status indicators, and tabs.
Ensure dark theme looks ultra-sleek with dark navy/obsidian cards (#0F1523) and neon status accents.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., 'transition: all'). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (no .App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
